SRC-021:R001.text: CORE-001: live ambience runtime reconciles with the authoritative persisted rule set; deleting or disabling an audible rule retires its layer; editing a live rule applies source/volume/repeat immediately and idempotently.

SRC-021:R002.text: CORE-002: weather fetch runs outside the engine lock and its worker cannot escape controller shutdown (generation/lifetime ownership).

SRC-021:R003.text: CORE-003: canonical ambience/i18n translation keys have zero structural validator errors.

SRC-021:R004.text: W2-001: a stale async sync observation is never mutation authority; a recreated binding cannot be detached by a late result.

SRC-021:R005.text: W2-002: portable-backup builds every COMPLETE generation from a provably clean per-generation scratch root that fails closed.

SRC-021:R006.text: W2-003: canonical backup recovery selection is deterministic/orderable, independent of filesystem enumeration order, including same-second ties.

SRC-021:R007.text: PERF-001: stable-source sound diagnostics are O(1) after warm-up (metadata/hash cache) with a bounded FIFO of 512.

SRC-021:R008.text: PERF-002: long valid WAVs render with bounded block resampling (65536) and the 30s/120s policy plus raw fallback, no full-duration stall.
